articles.headline: Palo Alto CEO says $1 trillion of cybersecurity infrastructure isn’t ready for AI
articles.summary: Palo Alto’s CEO said companies need to modernize roughly $1 trillion of aging cybersecurity infrastructure because AI-enabled attacks operate at machine speed. For businesses, this points to higher security spending, faster refresh cycles, and greater urgency to update defenses before deploying more AI tools.

articles.headline: Anthropic signs $35 billion cloud deal with Nvidia-backed Lambda
articles.summary: Anthropic’s reported $35 billion compute contract highlights how expensive frontier AI infrastructure has become and how concentrated demand for cloud capacity remains. For companies buying AI services or planning their own deployments, the deal signals continued pressure on compute availability and pricing across the ecosystem.

articles.headline: AI boom is driving a memory-chip shortage that could raise device prices
articles.summary: AI data centers are tightening memory supply, which is already pushing up costs for phones and computers. Businesses that buy hardware at scale should expect budget pressure, longer lead times, and potentially higher prices for servers, endpoints, and storage-related components.
